mechanism_narrative: Persistent depression in TRANSIT mobility (averaging -25.6% over four weeks) signals sustained avoidance of public transportation, which reduces incidental retail exposure during commutes and shopping trips, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT averaged -25.6% across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days increases relative to the prior 28-day mean despite TRANSIT remaining below -20% in all four weeks of the forecast period.

mechanism_narrative: Stable GROCERY_PHARM mobility (ranging -2.7% to -4.4%) indicates maintained essential shopping, which crowds out discretionary retail visits. This substitution effect suppresses RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains between -5% and 0% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM variance is 1.7 percentage points across four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises by more than 5 percentage points in weeks 1-2 of the forecast period while GROCERY_PHARM stays within the -5% to 0% band.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility (averaging 7.6% above baseline) combined with depressed WORKPLACES (averaging -17.0%) indicates remote work persistence and home-centered activity. This spatial reallocation reduces retail foot traffic in commercial districts, suppressing RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 3 percentage points over the next 28 days while both RESIDENTIAL remains above 6% and WORKPLACES remains below -14% in at least three of four forecast weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Depressed PARKS mobility (averaging -9.2% over four weeks) signals suppressed outdoor recreation, which typically precedes indoor retail activity shifts. If PARKS remains below -8% in the next two weeks, RETAIL_REC will decline as consumers delay discretionary purchases.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -8% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: PARKS remains below -8% for the entire forecast period yet RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 percentage points in weeks 3-4.

mechanism_narrative: Synchronized decline across TRANSIT (-25.3%), WORKPLACES (-14.9%), and RETAIL_REC (-17.0%) in the most recent week (t-0w) indicates active mobility restrictions or behavioral response to policy tightening. This synchronized suppression will persist into week 1-2 of the forecast, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT < -24% AND WORKPLACES < -15% AND RETAIL_REC < -16% in same week
evidence_refs: fact:All three series depressed in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -10% in week 1 of the forecast period while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below their t-0w levels.

mechanism_narrative: Modest week-on-week volatility in RETAIL_REC (range: -17.9% to -17.0%, std dev 0.4 pp) indicates a stable suppression regime with no trend signal. Absent a shock to TRANSIT or WORKPLACES, RETAIL_REC will remain in the -17% to -16% band over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC range 0.9 pp over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds -16.5% or falls below -17.5%, indicating a regime shift not explained by the stable recent pattern.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility shows deterioration from t-2w (-14.9%) to t-1w (-22.1%), a 7.2 pp drop signaling accelerating workplace avoidance. If this downward trend continues into week 1 of the forecast, RETAIL_REC will decline further as commute-linked retail exposure collapses.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES declines by more than 5 pp week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell 7.2 pp from t-2w to t-1w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES stabilizes or rebounds by more than 3 pp in week 1 of the forecast, yet RETAIL_REC still declines by more than 1 pp.

mechanism_narrative: Inverse relationship between RESIDENTIAL elevation (7.3% in t-0w) and RETAIL_REC depression (-17.0% in t-0w) reflects a home-centric consumption pattern. If RESIDENTIAL remains elevated above 6% while TRANSIT stays below -24%, the substitution of home-based for retail-based consumption will suppress RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases by more than 4 percentage points over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above 6% and TRANSIT remains below -24% in at least two of four forecast weeks.
